title: SpendPredicateV1
description: Reusable rule over one or more Spend Attestations. A Spend Predicate is downstream of attestation truth and does not mint a Spend Attestation Token.
$comment: Derived from 04-condition-layer/condition.md and 04-condition-layer/condition-evaluation.md. parameters and ruleExpression are non-empty profile-defined objects. evaluationContext binds scope, verifier policy, and replay/nullifier rules. predicateHash covers the complete predicate with only predicateHash omitted.

predicateHash.description: sha256: plus lowercaseHex(SHA-256(RFC8785_canonicalize(predicate with only predicateHash omitted))).

parameters.description: Profile-defined values bound into the predicate and its content hash.

verifierPolicyRef.description: Content address of the VerificationPolicy bound during evaluation.

replayNullifierRules.description: Profile-defined replay and nullifier requirements bound into the evaluation context.

ruleExpression.description: Non-empty profile-defined rule expression. Its complete structure participates in predicateHash.
